content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AUD Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Dr. B.R. Ambedkar University Delhi (AUD Delhi) for filling various Guest Faculty positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies available for the Guest Faculty posts across various disciplines.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for AUD Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Eligible candidates need to attend the walk-in interview directly at the designated venue.

faq.question: Q4. What is the date of the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview and registration are scheduled to take place on 06 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in the relevant subject with 55% marks along with NET/SLET/SET or a Ph.D. degree.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is set at 70 years, specifically applicable to superannuated teachers joining the faculty position.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive ₹1500/- per lecture, subject to a maximum limit of ₹50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview take place?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the School of Legal and Socio-Political Studies (SLPS), Dr. B.R. Ambedkar University Delhi, Lothian Road, Karampura Campus, Delhi – 110 015.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring all original certificates and mark sheets along with attested photocopies, a recent passport-size photograph, and an updated Bio-data.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for these posts?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for attending the walk-in interview.
